reasoning_content: Interesting — the /etc/hosts entry was added, and when I curl the auth URL directly (with the `dex` host resolving to 127.0.0.1), Dex returned a 302 (not a 200 login form). With skipApprovalScreen and prompt=login, Dex normally shows the login page. A 302 might be a redirect to /dex/auth with a different query, or maybe to the login page itself. Let me follow it.

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
AUTH_URL=$(cat dex_auth_url.txt)
curl -s -c dex_cookies.txt --max-time 10 -D dex_h1.txt "$AUTH_URL" -o dex_auth.html
cat dex_h1.txt | head -8
curl -s -b dex_cookies.txt -c dex_cookies.txt --max-time 10 -L "$AUTH_URL" -o dex_auth2.html -w "final: [%{http_code}] url=[%{url_effective}]\n"
grep -o 'name="_csrf" value="[^"]*"' dex_auth2.html | head -1

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
AUTH_URL=$(cat dex_auth_url.txt)
curl -s -c dex_cookies.txt --max-time 10 -D dex_h1.txt "$AUTH_URL" -o dex_auth.html
cat dex_h1.txt | head -8
curl -s -b dex_cookies.txt -c dex_cookies.txt --max-time 10 -L "$AUTH_URL" -o dex_auth2.html -w "final: [%{http_code}] url=[%{url_effective}]\n"
grep -o 'name="_csrf" value="[^"]*"' dex_auth2.html | head -1", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Follow Dex auth redirect chain"}
